memories.author: D06
memories.text:
function: Independent in ADLs, works full-time as hotel manager, reports occasional vertigo triggered by rapid head movements, no difficulty with daily chores.
cognition: Mini-Cog score 4/5 (negative screen).
falls: 0 falls in past 12 months, gait normal, timed up-and-go 9 seconds (normal fall risk).
medicines: 0 regular.
mood: Reports mild anxiety about vertigo episodes, denies depression or hopelessness.
carers: Mother, Lakshmi.
goals: "I want to control vertigo so I can work without fear of dizziness."

memories.author: D06
memories.text: betahistine 16 mg twice daily for 3 months; meclizine 25 mg as needed for vertigo, max 3 doses per day, for 3 months.

memories.author: D06
memories.text:
function: Reports fewer vertigo episodes, able to work full shifts, ADLs independent.
cognition: (Mini-Cog not repeated this visit; previous score 4/5 remains negative).
falls: 0 falls in last 12 months, gait steady, timed up-and-go 8 seconds (normal risk).
medicines: 1 regular (betahistine 16 mg BD).
mood: Anxiety reduced, denies depressive symptoms.
carers: Mother, Lakshmi.
goals: "I want to stay vertigo-free to manage my hotel duties without interruption."

memories.author: lab
memories.text: Pure-tone audiometry: Right ear thresholds 250 Hz 10 dB, 500 Hz 10 dB, 1000 Hz 10 dB, 2000 Hz 15 dB, 4000 Hz 20 dB, 8000 Hz 25 dB; Left ear thresholds 250 Hz 5 dB, 500 Hz 5 dB, 1000 Hz 5 dB, 2000 Hz 10 dB, 4000 Hz 15 dB, 8000 Hz 20 dB. All within normal limits (<25 dB).

memories.text: Appointment booked for 2025-09-10 at 10:30 AM with Dr Nandini Kulkarni (D06).

memories.text: Dix‑Hallpike test: Positive posterior canal BPPV on the right; torsional up‑beating nystagmus lasting <1 minute. No neurological deficits.
